definitions.gloss: mourning; period of mourning after a death
definitions.explanation: The period of grief and abstention from celebrations following the death of a family member or close relative. Traditionally lasting 49 days in Buddhism.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}が{亡|な}くなり、{喪|も}に{服|ふく}している。
examples.english: My grandfather passed away and I am in mourning.

examples.japanese: {喪|も}が{明|あ}けるまでは{祝|いわ}い{事|ごと}を{控|ひか}える{習慣|しゅうかん}がある。
examples.english: There is a custom of refraining from celebratory events until the mourning period ends.

notes:
{喪|も}に{服|ふく}す (to be in mourning) is the most common set phrase. The mourning period is called {喪中|もちゅう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {喪|も}に{服|ふく}す: to observe mourning, to be in mourning
- {喪中|もちゅう}: in mourning (period)
- {喪服|もふく}: mourning dress/clothes
- {喪主|もしゅ}: chief mourner
- {喪|も}が{明|あ}ける: for the mourning period to end

USAGE:
{喪中|もちゅう} is written on postcards (喪中はがき) sent to notify people that the sender will not be sending New Year's greeting cards.
